text.en: Executive Order Nos. 787 and 842, Series of 2009, are hereby

All Executive Orders, rules, regulations and other issuances or parts
thereof which are inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive Order are hereby
repealed, amended or otherwise modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 4th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, Two
Thousand and Ten.
By the President:
LEANDRO R. MENDOZA
Execktive Secretary
PGMA Holagram / 56948
